title: Can You Remember 15 Synonyms for BIG? (Memory Challenge)
description:
Ten words for BIG in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole BIG ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from big to extremely big: large, considerable, bulky, hefty, jumbo, huge, giant, enormous, massive, whopping, vast, towering, mammoth, immense, ginormous. For each word, you learn what it means and when to use it: for sizes and amounts, for money ("a hefty bill"), for products ("a jumbo pack"), for tall things, for feelings ("immense relief"), in formal English or in casual chat with friends (informal).

Then try it with your own new words: one silly story, one picture for each word.

For more words, look up "another word for big" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-big/
